title: Line slices of the Steiner symmetral have the length of the slices of A
statement: Let d ∈ ℕ, j ∈ Fin d and let A ⊆ ℝ^d = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) be compact. For x ∈ ℝ^d and s ∈ ℝ let x[j↦s] be x with its j-th coordinate replaced by s (Lean: WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update x.ofLp j s)). Let A^j_x := {s ∈ ℝ : x[j↦s] ∈ A} and S_j(A) := {x ∈ ℝ^d : A^j_x ≠ ∅ and |x_j| ≤ (L¹(A^j_x)).toReal/2}. Then for every y ∈ ℝ^d, L¹({t ∈ ℝ : y[j↦t] ∈ S_j(A)}) = L¹(A^j_y), where L¹ is the volume (Lebesgue measure) of ℝ.
lean_statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (j : Fin d) (A : Set (Euclid d)), IsCompact A → ∀ y : Euclid d, volume {t : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t) ∈ {x : Euclid d | {s : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update x.ofLp j s) ∈ A}.Nonempty ∧ |x j| ≤ (volume {s : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update x.ofLp j s) ∈ A}).toReal / 2}} = volume {t : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t) ∈ A}
